WP3 ordered model ladder (baselines, RF/XGBoost, Bayesian/hierarchical) with multi-horizon forecasting, calibration, UQ; D3.1/D3.2.
Simplest-adequate-model parsimony principle introducing deep architectures only where sample size justifies.
Temporal/geographic transferability measured (LOYO, zero-shot MATE->MVCRI, local calibration, hierarchical adaptation) instantiating H3/H4; D4.1-D4.3.
WP5 closes chain with irrigation-priority logic, FDV, DrR web MVP, farmer-field transfer, nine-dimension assessment, FMIS roadmap; H5/H6.
